scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
If you fought Morocc
and collected
Hero Tokens,
I can exchange them with a special ring for you.
Do you want to take a look at my ring?
scripts.translation:
[英雄代幣兌換員]
如果您對抗夢羅克時收集到了英雄代幣，可以來我這裡兌換一枚特別的戒指。
要看看嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
Your pack has a lot of items,
Please come again after arrange it!
scripts.translation:
[英雄代幣兌換員]
您攜帶的物品太多了，請整理好物品欄再來吧！

scripts.text: Ring description
scripts.translation: 戒指說明

scripts.text: Exchange with the ring.
scripts.translation: 兌換戒指

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
This Hero Ring
may not
look
impressive,
scripts.translation:
[英雄代幣兌換員]
這枚勇士之戒看起來也許並不起眼...

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
but take it to
Expert Enchanter Byrnes,
and he can Enchant
all 4 sockets in it
and bring out
its latent abilities.
scripts.translation:
[英雄代幣兌換員]
但只要交給附魔專家伯恩斯，他就能為它的全部4個插槽附魔，激發戒指潛藏的力量。

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
Hero Ring
can aid you
in subjugating
Morocc.
Any more questions?
scripts.translation:
[英雄代幣兌換員]
勇士之戒能助您討伐夢羅克。
還有什麼想問的嗎？

scripts.text:
- Hero Ring -
^006400A ring made for warriors^000000
^006400on the quest to defeat Morocc..^000000
^006400When Enchanted,^000000
^006400it lends its owner^000000
^006400the power to confront Morocc.^000000
^006400Clas: Accessory/DEF: 0^000000
^006400Weight: 20/Required Level: 160^000000
^006400Slot: 0/Equip To: All Jobs^000000

[Hero Token Exchanger]
Hero Ring requires
30 Hero Tokens
for the exchange.
Do you want to exchange?
scripts.translation:
[英雄代幣兌換員]
兌換一枚勇士之戒需要30個英雄代幣。
您要兌換嗎？

scripts.text: Previous menu.
scripts.translation: 返回上一級選單

scripts.text: Exchange 30 Hero Tokens.
scripts.translation: 用30個英雄代幣兌換

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
Think
again.
scripts.translation:
[英雄代幣兌換員]
再考慮一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
^006400Hero Token^000000
is given to
those who bravely fought Morocc.
You don't have
30 ^006400Hero Tokens^000000,
and therefore I can't assist you.
scripts.translation:
[英雄代幣兌換員]
^006400英雄代幣^000000是對勇敢對抗夢羅克之人的獎勵。
您沒有湊齊30個^006400英雄代幣^000000，我沒法為您兌換。

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
I'll exchange
30 ^006400Hero Tokens^000000
with 1 ^006400Hero Ring^000000.
Anything else?
scripts.translation:
[英雄代幣兌換員]
這就用您的30個^006400英雄代幣^000000兌換1枚^006400勇士之戒^000000。
還有其他需要嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hero Token Exchanger]
One day
you'll find yourself
in need of Hero Ring.
scripts.translation:
[英雄代幣兌換員]
總有一天，您會需要這枚勇士之戒的。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Have you heard of Hero Ring? Only true heroes deserve to possess that magnificent ring, and I've been waiting for one.
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您聽說過勇士之戒嗎？
只有真正的英雄才配擁有那枚華麗的戒指，我一直在等待這樣的英雄。
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: Enchant Hero Ring.
scripts.translation: 附魔勇士之戒

scripts.text: Reset Enchantments on Hero Ring.
scripts.translation: 重置勇士之戒的附魔

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
I can Enchant only equipped rings. Which one of the equipped rings do you want to Enchant?
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
我只能為已裝備的戒指附魔。
您想為哪一枚戒指附魔？

scripts.text: Left
scripts.translation: 左側戒指

scripts.text: Right
scripts.translation: 右側戒指

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Please equip the Hero Ring that you want to enchant.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
請先裝備您想附魔的勇士之戒。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Please equip your Hero Ring. I can't Enchant anything else.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
請裝備您的勇士之戒，我只能為這種戒指附魔。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
A fully enchanted Hero Ring cannot be enchanted any further.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
完全附魔的勇士之戒無法再進行附魔。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Which ability do you want as an enchantment on slot {0}?
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您想為第{0}個插槽附加哪種能力？

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Enchantment completed!
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
附魔完成！

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
To reset Enchantments on your Hero Ring, I need 3 Hero Tokens.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
要重置勇士之戒的附魔，我需要3個英雄代幣。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
You don't have enough Hero Tokens. I can't reset your Hero Ring.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您的英雄代幣不夠，無法重置勇士之戒的附魔。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
I can reset only equipped rings. Which one of the equipped rings do you want to reset?
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
我只能重置已裝備戒指的附魔。
您想重置哪一枚？

scripts.text: Left
scripts.translation: 左側戒指

scripts.text: Right
scripts.translation: 右側戒指

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
You first have to equip the item to reset its Enchantment status.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您必須先裝備該物品，才能重置其附魔狀態。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Please equip your Hero Ring. I can't reset anything else.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
請裝備您的勇士之戒，我只能重置這種戒指的附魔。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
You don't have enough Hero Tokens. I can't reset your Hero Ring.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您的英雄代幣不夠，無法重置勇士之戒的附魔。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Your Hero Ring is currently in a state without enchantment.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
您的勇士之戒還沒有附魔。

scripts.text:
[Byrnes]
Initialization completed.
scripts.translation:
[伯恩斯]
附魔已重置。
